author: ojiudezue
title: v5.96.2 shipped: BLE mop-up: exit-display re-read + naive-UTC day boundary + listener cleanup
summary: BLE mop-up: exit-display re-read + naive-UTC day boundary + listener cleanup
why: Two low-severity display/count correctness gaps surfaced by the v5.96.1 reviews plus a pre-existing listener leak on the same sensors. The exit list never re-read after a backfill so shipped exit names were invisible until restart; the today-counts used local midnight against a naive-UTC column so they over-counted the prior evening. Fixed together as the sequence's BLE mop-up; the listener leak was two lines in the same file and a real dead-entity-update-on-reload HIGH, so fixed in-place rather than carded.
implications: Shipped EGRESS-EXIT-DISPLAY-REREAD-1, EGRESS-SENSOR-READER-TZ-OVERCOUNT-1 at v5.96.2; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.96.2.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: Post-restart: persons-entered/exited-today reset at local midnight not 19:00 prior day; a backfilled exit shows the named person in the exit list without a restart

refs.release_notes: Step-3 mop-up of the identity sequence. Exit-display list refreshes when v5.96.1 backfills a name (SIGNAL_EGRESS_EXIT_BACKFILLED + sensor re-read) instead of showing unidentified until restart. persons-entered/exited-today now compute the day boundary in naive-UTC to match the DB column (was over-counting ~5h of the prior evening at UTC-5). DB re-read rows normalized to the live entry shape. Pre-existing HIGH fixed: four count-sensor listeners now torn down via async_on_remove. 1 review SHIP + fix-up + orchestrator mutation-verify.
